text: Services run November 3–8 at America's Center in St. Louis, with the General Assembly November 9–10. About 60,000 delegates are expected for COGIC's first St. Louis convocation since 2019, with the city hosting through 2028.
title: 118th Holy Convocation — 'Answering The Call,' St. Louis, November 3–10, 2026

text: A communique from the Presiding Bishop's office mobilizes COGIC voters around the November 3, 2026 midterm elections — even as thousands of saints gather in St. Louis for Convocation the same week.
title: 2026 COGIC Counts: Getting Souls to the Polls

text: Bishop J. Drew Sheard issued a statement from Memphis marking twenty-five years since September 11, 2001, reflecting on resolve, grief, and a faith that refused to be broken.
title: Presiding Bishop's statement on the 25th anniversary of 9/11

text: Delegates voted on January 13, 2025 to bring the Holy Convocation back to St. Louis, its home from 2010 to 2019. Memphis, Presiding Bishop Sheard noted, will always be the spiritual home of the church.
title: General Assembly votes: Convocation returns to St. Louis, 2026–2028

text: Bishop J. Drew Sheard Sr., first elected on March 27, 2021, was re-elected by acclamation to a second four-year term as Presiding Bishop and Chief Apostle of the Church of God in Christ.
title: Bishop Sheard re-elected Presiding Bishop
